integrity: Proved statements and recorded deterministic/exact tests are distinguished; no formal or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: For each theta>0 and fixed d>=1, limits are taken in number of insertions n first; the threshold expansion is a separate large-d statement and is not uniform in the permutation size. Gnedin and Stark already establish the log-time functional limit. The source paper also shows failure of almost-sure convergence for occupation fractions. An independent mathematical audit and a complete historical-priority guarantee are absent.
title: A covariance sign transition for empirical fixed-point states in Ewens restaurant growth
